text:
Elliot: Who left banana bread in the kitchen? Smells suspiciously like someone's weekend flex. :banana:
Sam: Not me. But 10/10 would accept a slice.
Jules: I saw a sticky note that said 'Help yourself' but it had a tiny plant doodle on it. Could be from the plant parents group.
Nina: That was me! Made it for the plants meeting yesterday and forgot to put my name. Oops. Glad someone's enjoying it. :blush:
Elliot: Mystery solved. Verdict: delicious. Also please label food unless you want passive-aggressive sticky notes.
Sam: Also quick poll: whiteboard markers are basically at single-digit life. Red is gone. Thoughts on new markers?
Jules: Pick eco-friendly ones. My fav from last time lasted ages.
Nina: Vote by reaction: :green_heart: = eco markers, :blue_book: = just get the usual pack.
OfficeBot: Inventory check: markers remaining - black:5, blue:7, red:0, green:2.
Elliot: Eco markers it is. I'll order a mixed pack and some red spares.
Sam: Bless you. Also anyone claim the plant watering rota this week? The cactus is judging our attendance.
Jules: I'll do Monday and Tuesday. Sam you got Wednesday?
Sam: Yep, can take Weds. Nina can do Thu-Fri?
Nina: Yep, on it. Also will bring a little plant fertilizer because the fern looks dramatic.
Elliot: Thanks team. Banana bread survivors meetup at 3 for leftovers. :coffee:
OfficeBot: Calendar ping scheduled: 'Banana Bread Leftovers' 15:00 today.
Elliot: Thread closed unless more snacks spontaneously appear.
